ins/address-book/spec.md: The add form opened from the place of origin or consignor picker or the consignment contact page selects no country
The consignee, importer and place of destination pages offer every country, opening on United Kingdom
A consignee, importer or place of destination address is saved with the country chosen
An address from any role picker with no country, or one the list does not offer, is refused
An address holding sending, receiving or branch roles is saved outside the United Kingdom
Destination, Consignee or Importer offers its three roles and every country, opening on United Kingdom
Branch offers the one role and every country, opening on United Kingdom
A Destination or Branch address is saved with the country chosen
A Destination or Branch address names only the missing name, postcode and phone number and keeps the country chosen
